Budget Build Lab

Compare two complete purchase plans using your actual quotes. Include the whole platform and the extras.

Open PC builder

Keep the price basis explicit

Enter quotes in one currency. An empty field means unknown; enter zero only for an actual zero cost, or mark an item owned/not needed.

Plan A
Plan B

Totals appear when you enter quotes. Missing fields remain visible.

Compare the whole decision

A CPU-only quote can hide motherboard, memory, cooling and accessory changes. List every required purchase in both columns. For a phased upgrade, create a worksheet for each phase and recheck compatibility after each change.

This is a quote worksheet. It does not search every product, find an optimal build, convert currencies or provide current stock. A saved worksheet preserves your inputs on this device; it does not watch prices. Retail quotes can change before checkout.

Verify tradeoffs separately

A cheaper platform may meet your present application requirements while limiting later CPU choices. Compact cases require exact clearance checks. Noise needs comparable acoustic tests. A display resolution is a goal, not an FPS guarantee. Use the readiness report and original game/application tests alongside the quotes.

Existing platform cost calculatorBuild Readiness ReportPrice methodology

Data and privacy

Calculations run in your browser. Saving is optional and local. This form has no email field and no delivery service. Avoid including private identifiers in exported files.
